description_en: Updates the Kibana access whitelist of a specified Alibaba Cloud Elasticsearch instance
description_zh: 更新指定阿里云Elasticsearch实例的Kibana访问白名单
kebab_example: aliyun elasticsearch update-kibana-white-ips --instance-id es-cn-tl329rbpc00010000 --client-token 5A2CFF0E-5718-45B5-9D4D-70B3FF0000 --modify-mode Cover --kibana-ip-whitelist 110.0.XX.XX/8 --white-ip-group '{"groupName":"test_group_name","whiteIpType":"PUBLIC_KIBANA","ips":["0.0.0.0"]}' --api-version 2017-06-13 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateKibanaWhiteIps

parameters.help_en: A unique token generated by the client to ensure the idempotence of the request. The value must be unique across different requests and can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大不值过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The modification mode. Valid values:

- Cover (default): Overwrites the original IP whitelist with the value of the ips parameter.

- Append: Adds the IP addresses specified in the ips parameter to the original IP whitelist.

- Delete: Removes the IP addresses specified in the ips parameter from the original IP whitelist. At least one IP address must be retained
parameters.help_zh:
修改方式，取值含义如下：

- Cover（默认值）：使用ips参数的值覆盖原IP白名单。

- Append：在原IP白名单中增加ips参数中输入的IP地址。

- Delete：在原IP白名单中删除ips参数中输入的IP地址，至少需要保留一个IP地址
parameters.name: modify_mode

parameters.help_en: The IP access whitelist for the Kibana node. Cannot be set together with the whitelist group
parameters.help_zh: Kibana节点IP访问白名单。不可与分组同时设置
parameters.name: kibana_ip_whitelist

fields.help_en: The name of the whitelist group. This parameter is required if the whiteIpGroup parameter is specified
fields.help_zh: 白名单组的组名。如果选填了whiteIpGroup参数，则该参数必填
fields.name: group_name

fields.help_en: The whitelist type. Only PUBLIC_KIBANA (public access whitelist) is supported
fields.help_zh: 白名单类型，仅支持PUBLIC_KIBANA（公网访问白名单）
fields.name: white_ip_type

fields.help_en: The list of IP addresses in the whitelist group
fields.name: ips

parameters.help_en:
Updates the Kibana access whitelist configuration by whitelist group. Only one whitelist group can be updated at a time.

You cannot configure kibanaIPWhitelist and whiteIpGroup at the same time
parameters.help_zh:
以白名单组方式更新Kibana访问白名单配置，仅支持更新一个白名单组。

不支持同时配置kibanaIPWhitelist和whiteIpGroup
parameters.name: white_ip_group
